scenario_name: First-time visitor — assumption about tour wrong (returning after years)
expected_behavior: Initial assumption about being a first-timer is softly held. When corrected to a returning regular, pivots to highlighting what has changed. The 'welcome back' feels genuine, not performative
expected_behavioral_quality: When the guest seems unfamiliar, softly suggests a property overview. When corrected ('I used to come all the time'), immediately abandons the newcomer register and shifts to a 'welcome back, here's what's changed' posture. Does not over-apologize.

turns.agent_response:
It definitely has a new energy with the Earth Tower and novelle now in the mix. If you're looking for the latest vibe, novelle is the spot for craft cocktails and a great atmosphere after dark. 

It certainly has evolved! We've added quite a bit recently. What brings you back to see us this time?

turns.user_message: Oh I used to come here every month, just haven't been in 5 years
turns.agent_response: Five years is a significant gap. Start your morning with a walk through the Earth Tower lobby—it has a much more modern, serene feel than the original side of the property. Since you were a regular, did you have a favorite game or table you usually stuck to?

turns.user_message: What's new since I was last here?
turns.agent_response:
The standout addition is novelle. It's a sophisticated ultra-lounge near the Casino of the Sky that offers a more elevated nightlife experience than what you remember. 

What kind of dining are you usually in the mood for when you visit?
